# Final energy consumption chart queries

The queries in this folder are generated by `generate_fec_query_set.py` from
`final_energy_consumption_query_set_v3_*.csv`. Each query refers to the query
with the same name (without the `myc_`, `myc_carrier_` or `myc_sector_` prefix) in
`gqueries/general/final_energy_consumption`.

**Do not edit these queries by hand.** Changes made directly in these files are
lost when the query set is regenerated. Make the change in the CSV or the
generator instead, and regenerate the queries.
